method: Two official public catalog previews per current composition, fetched and decoded in memory only. Source recordings are not saved, sampled, transcribed or passed to synthesis. YouTube engagement references are separately documented.
engagementNote: Indexed public view/like counts are a popularity indicator, not a sleep-effect or acoustic-quality rating. Some secondary arrangements have few views and are marked as secondary references.
comparisonScope: 24 approximately30-second official previews measured, plus public YouTube engagement/context and previously measured CC0/BY physical-instrument references. No reference recording saved, reused, sampled or transcribed. Preview pulse candidates are ambiguous envelope periodicities, not authoritative score BPM.

decisions.tuning: A440 equal temperament; exact integer harmonic modes; no pitch modulation or random timing

tempo.reason: Slightly more space around rolling figures; preserve existing phrase timing and melody.
Ease the busy variation passages; retain the steady ground bass and note ordering.
Already slow quarter-note pulse; only a small relaxation to preserve the long melodic line.
Give ornaments breathing space while preserving the compound-meter flow and source rubato.
Reduce the repeated high-note figure's urgency; retain relative rhythm and all original sections.
Gentle broadening of lyrical phrases; keep the existing expressive tempo map.
Retain the cradle-like three-beat motion with a modestly calmer pulse.
Widen breathing space between the simple vocal phrases without altering note durations relative to the beat.
Use an unhurried single-note pulse; preserve the familiar phrase shapes and rests.
Already the longest, slowest quarter-note source; a small increase in flow avoids over-stretching sustained melody.
Leave more room after bass/chord attacks while preserving the three-beat phrase and original voicing.
Already a relaxed Largo arrangement; keep a natural singing line with only slight slowing.

decisions.decisionNote: Tempo choices are conservative engineering/artistic inferences from the source score and multiple preview comparisons, not claimed BPM transcriptions or clinically validated sleep settings. Relative source timing, pitches, velocities and voicing stay intact. Static per-recording K-weighted gated loudness normalization uses the previous twelve-recording median, preserving the existing master volume mapping and avoiding dynamic pumping.
